# agy-fleet-mcp — full LLM reference

> Long-form index for agents. Tight index: `llms.txt`.

## Identity

- **Name:** agy-fleet-mcp
- **Version:** 0.1.0
- **Stack:** FastMCP 3.2+, Python 3.11+, uv, pydantic-settings
- **Role:** Config plane — MCP JSON sync for Antigravity CLI
- **Not:** agy-mcp (PyPI) — that exposes agy as MCP tools
- **Transports:** stdio (default), HTTP (`--serve`, `/mcp` on **10825**)
- **Changelog:** `CHANGELOG.md`

## Tool surface (8 tools)

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `agy_fleet_help` | Package vs agy-mcp overview |
| `agy_fleet_list_locations` | Known config paths + exists flags |
| `agy_fleet_list_servers` | Servers in a source (enabled/disabled counts) |
| `agy_fleet_diff` | Set diff between two locations |
| `agy_fleet_sync` | Merge/replace sync; `dry_run` default true |
| `agy_fleet_validate` | Command validation + `agy` binary status |
| `agy_fleet_registry` | Read fleet-registry.json summary |
| `agy_fleet_apply_tool_budget` | Cap enabled servers (default 50) |

## Config location IDs

`cursor` | `gemini` | `antigravity_cli` | `antigravity_ide` | `project`

| ID | Default path |
|----|--------------|
| cursor | `~/.cursor/mcp.json` |
| gemini | `~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json` |
| antigravity_cli | `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/mcp_config.json` |
| antigravity_ide | `~/.gemini/antigravity/mcp_config.json` |
| project | `./.antigravitycli/mcp_config.json` |

## Recommended workflow

1. `agy_fleet_list_locations`
2. `agy_fleet_diff(left="cursor", right="gemini")`
3. `agy_fleet_sync(source="cursor", target="gemini", dry_run=true)`
4. User confirms → `dry_run=false`
5. `agy_fleet_apply_tool_budget(source="gemini", max_enabled=50, priority=[...])`

## Environment (prefix `AGY_FLEET_MCP_`)

- `HOST` — default `127.0.0.1`
- `PORT` — default `10825` (was 10793; avatar-mcp uses 10793)
- `CURSOR_MCP_PATH`, `GEMINI_MCP_PATH`, `ANTIGRAVITY_CLI_MCP_PATH`, `ANTIGRAVITY_IDE_MCP_PATH`
- `FLEET_REGISTRY_PATH` — fleet catalog JSON
- `MAX_ENABLED_SERVERS` — default 50
- `BACKUP_ON_WRITE` — default true

## HTTP endpoints

| Endpoint | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `GET /health` | `{"status":"ok","service":"agy-fleet-mcp"}` |
| `POST /mcp` | Streamable HTTP MCP |

## MCPB / Claude Desktop

- `manifest.json` v0.2 + `assets/icon.png` + `assets/prompts/*`
- Pack: `just mcpb-pack`
- `.mcpbignore` excludes `docs/`, `skills/`, `llms*.txt`

## Skills

- `skill://agy-fleet` — `skills/agy-fleet/SKILL.md`

## Fleet integrations

- **fleet-registry.json** — `agy_fleet_registry`
- **fleet-agent-mcp** — optional HTTP at `http://127.0.0.1:10825/mcp`
- **notebooklm-fleet-mcp** — separate; sync via Cursor config, not this tool

## Safety rules for agents

- Always `dry_run=true` first on `agy_fleet_sync` and `agy_fleet_apply_tool_budget`
- Never sync to `cursor` target without explicit user request
- Read diff output before write

## Troubleshooting

| Issue | Fix |
|-------|-----|
| Port 10825 in use | `AGY_FLEET_MCP_PORT` |
| Wrong file written | Check `source`/`target` IDs |
| Too many tools in agy | `agy_fleet_apply_tool_budget` |

Full: `docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`
